"Walk Away (Remember Me)" is a song by American singer-songwriter Paula DeAnda.
Written by Ne-Yo and Christina Milian together with producers Stargate, it was released in the United States in November 2006 as DeAnda's second single and features The D.E.Y..
The song is about feelings from an old relationship that have resurfaced once the protagonist has seen her ex's new girlfriend.
